"""Owned, one-shot vendor Python image preparation; no calls on import."""

import asyncio
import base64
import hashlib
import json
import os
import pathlib
import re
import runpy
import subprocess
import sys
import threading
import time
import zlib

REPO = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
CLI = pathlib.Path("C:/Users/w.filho/AppData/Local/Programs/DockerDesktop/resources/bin/docker.exe")
HOME = pathlib.Path(os.environ["USERPROFILE"])
HELPER = REPO / "docs/poc/run_linux_as_probe.py"
PAYLOAD = REPO / "deploy/oracle9_python_payload.py"
DOWNLOADER = REPO / "docs/poc/oracle9_rpm_download.py"
PREP_CAPS = frozenset(
    {
        "CAP_CHOWN",
        "CAP_DAC_OVERRIDE",
        "CAP_FOWNER",
        "CAP_SETFCAP",
        "CAP_SETUID",
        "CAP_SETGID",
        "CAP_SYS_CHROOT",
    }
)
META = (
    HOME
    / ".docker/contexts/meta/fe9c6bd7a66301f49ca9b6a70b217107cd1284598bfc254700c989b916da791e/meta.json"
)
IMAGE = "sha256:d8c0a1f95f3394a2b40ece95dbff199cea94d06ac0ed354a7b88e96e2df5bb94"
PATH_ENV = "PATH=/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin"
BASE_LAYERS = ["sha256:c8033153c9465fa4e4f02df8b57cda30011514f5b1e7438bf521776e63f0abaf"]
ENTRY = ["/opt/maskgw/venv/bin/python", "-I", "-B"]
ENV = [
    PATH_ENV,
    "HOME=/var/empty",
    "LANG=C.UTF-8",
    "PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1",
    "PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1",
]
PINS = {
    HELPER: "58c692a775a2dffdaa6be86866cdb15ddb307f97aeb8a04b4f7c737ea56c3627",
    CLI: "60028870931ea6e91955bfeaee358ec6c6920f6162c17a3d828c3c82ab3c3599",
    HOME
    / ".docker/config.json": "f173396ef80b3c0bf4f8a5f6f944d3e426cee041ae3a2a8a07602ff6846a9f1a",
    META: "c16649b1a2f1c6fbb68b85158a956862331e86543e25df46341f5fe5df2f9a25",
}


def require(value):
    if not value:
        raise RuntimeError("PREPARATION_REFUSED")


def pins():
    require(all(hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == v for p, v in PINS.items()))
    require(
        json.loads(META.read_bytes())["Endpoints"]["docker"]["Host"]
        in ("npipe:////./pipe/dockerDesktopLinuxEngine", "npipe://./pipe/dockerDesktopLinuxEngine")
    )


def save(path, value):
    data = (json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True) + "\n").encode()
    require(len(data) <= 4 * 1024 * 1024)
    with path.with_suffix(path.suffix + ".next").open("xb") as f:
        f.write(data)
        f.flush()
        os.fsync(f.fileno())
    os.replace(f.name, path)


def shell(payload, task):
    require(re.fullmatch("[0-9a-f]{32}", task) is not None)
    rows = runpy.run_path(str(DOWNLOADER))["manifest_rows"]()
    packages = " ".join("/opt/maskgw/" + v["filename"] for v in rows)
    script = r"""set -euo pipefail
exec 2>&1
printf '@@STAGE@@BASELINE\n'
test -d /opt
test ! -e /opt/maskgw
test ! -L /opt/maskgw
test -d /maskgw-rpm-input-TASK_ID
test ! -L /maskgw-rpm-input-TASK_ID
mv /maskgw-rpm-input-TASK_ID /opt/maskgw
chmod 0755 /opt/maskgw
chmod 0644 /opt/maskgw/*
chown 0:0 /opt/maskgw/*
for input in /opt/maskgw/*; do
    [[ "$(stat -c '%u:%g:%a' "$input")" == '0:0:644' ]]
    stat -c '%n|%u|%g|%a' "$input"
done
cd /opt/maskgw
sha256sum --check inputs.sha256
printf '%s  runtime_probe.py\n' PAYLOAD_SHA | sha256sum --check
mkdir -p /opt/maskgw/keydb
rpm --dbpath /opt/maskgw/keydb --initdb
rpm --dbpath /opt/maskgw/keydb --import /etc/pki/rpm-gpg/RPM-GPG-KEY-oracle
rpm --dbpath /opt/maskgw/keydb -qa --qf '%{NAME}|%{ARCH}|%{EPOCHNUM}|%{VERSION}|%{RELEASE}\n' > /opt/maskgw/allowed-keys.txt
rpm --dbpath /opt/maskgw/keydb -qa --qf '%{VERSION}\n' > /opt/maskgw/allowed-keyids.txt
rpm -qa --qf '%{NAME}|%{ARCH}|%{EPOCHNUM}|%{VERSION}|%{RELEASE}\n' | LC_ALL=C sort > /opt/maskgw/rpm-before.txt
if rpm -Va > /opt/maskgw/verify-before.txt; then :; else test "$?" -eq 1; fi
cp /etc/os-release /opt/maskgw/os-before
cp /etc/passwd /opt/maskgw/passwd-before
cp /etc/group /opt/maskgw/group-before
if [[ ! -e /var/cache/ldconfig && ! -L /var/cache/ldconfig ]]; then
    printf 'absent\n' > /opt/maskgw/cache-dir-before.txt
else
    printf 'present\n' > /opt/maskgw/cache-dir-before.txt
fi
find /usr /etc /var/log /tmp /var/tmp /root -print > /opt/maskgw/paths-before.txt
find /etc -type f -readable -exec sha256sum {} + > /opt/maskgw/etc-before.txt
rpm --import /etc/pki/rpm-gpg/RPM-GPG-KEY-oracle
packages=(PACKAGES)
printf '@@STAGE@@SIGNATURES\n'
for package in "${packages[@]}"; do
    verified=$(rpm --define '_pkgverify_level all' -K "$package")
    [[ "$verified" == *'signatures OK'* && "$verified" != *NOKEY* && "$verified" != *'NOT OK'* ]]
    printf '%s\n' "$verified"
    signature=$(rpm --define '_pkgverify_level all' -qp --qf '%{RSAHEADER:pgpsig}' "$package")
    keyid="${signature##*Key ID }"
    [[ "$keyid" =~ ^[0-9a-fA-F]{8,16}$ ]]
    short="${keyid: -8}"
    found=false
    while read -r allowed; do
        if [[ "${allowed,,}" == "${short,,}" ]]; then found=true; fi
    done < /opt/maskgw/allowed-keyids.txt
    "$found"
done
rpm --define '_pkgverify_level all' -qp --qf '%{NAME}|%{ARCH}|%{EPOCHNUM}|%{VERSION}|%{RELEASE}\n' "${packages[@]}" | LC_ALL=C sort > /opt/maskgw/actual-rpms.txt
[[ "$(cat /opt/maskgw/expected-rpms.txt)" == "$(cat /opt/maskgw/actual-rpms.txt)" ]]
rpm --define '_pkgverify_level all' -qp --qf '[%{FILENAMES}|%{FILEMODES:octal}\n]' "${packages[@]}" > /opt/maskgw/declared-modes.txt
while IFS='|' read -r filename mode; do
    [[ "$filename" == /* && "$mode" =~ ^[0-7]+$ ]]
    (( (8#$mode & 06000) == 0 ))
done < /opt/maskgw/declared-modes.txt
rpm --define '_pkgverify_level all' -qp --qf '%|FILECAPS?{[%{FILECAPS}\n]}:{(none)\n}|' "${packages[@]}" > /opt/maskgw/declared-caps.txt
while IFS= read -r caps; do
    [[ -z "$caps" || "$caps" == '(none)' ]]
done < /opt/maskgw/declared-caps.txt
printf '@@STAGE@@DEPENDENCIES\n'
rpm --define '_pkgverify_level all' --test -i "${packages[@]}"
printf '@@STAGE@@INSTALL\n'
rpm --define '_pkgverify_level all' -ivh "${packages[@]}"
export PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1
printf '@@STAGE@@VENV\n'
python3.11 -B -m venv /opt/maskgw/venv
/opt/maskgw/venv/bin/python -I -B /opt/maskgw/runtime_probe.py finish
"""
    return (
        script.replace("PACKAGES", packages)
        .replace("PAYLOAD_SHA", hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest())
        .replace("TASK_ID", task)
    )


def identity(info, name, task, image):
    require(info["Name"] == "/" + name and info["Config"]["Labels"].get("maskgw.task") == task)
    require(info["Image"] == image and re.fullmatch("[0-9a-f]{64}", info["Id"]))
    return info["Id"]


def profile(info, image, command, prep):
    c, h = info["Config"], info["HostConfig"]
    require(c["Image"] == image and c["Env"] == ([PATH_ENV] if prep else ENV))
    require(c["User"] == ("0:0" if prep else "10001:10001"))
    require(c["Entrypoint"] == (["/bin/bash"] if prep else ENTRY) and c["Cmd"] == command)
    require(not info["Mounts"] and c["Healthcheck"]["Test"] == ["NONE"])
    require(h["ReadonlyRootfs"] is (not prep) and h["Privileged"] is False)
    mem, fds, pids = (2 * 1024 * 1024 * 1024, 256, 64) if prep else (128 * 1024 * 1024, 64, 16)
    require(h["Memory"] == h["MemorySwap"] == mem and h["PidsLimit"] == pids)
    require(h["NanoCpus"] == 1000000000 and h["ShmSize"] == 1048576)
    require(h["NetworkMode"] == "none" and h["IpcMode"] == h["CgroupnsMode"] == "private")
    require(not h.get("PidMode") and not h.get("UTSMode") and not h.get("Init"))
    additions = h.get("CapAdd") or []
    require(type(additions) is list and all(type(v) is str for v in additions))
    normalized = {v if v.startswith("CAP_") else "CAP_" + v for v in additions}
    require(
        h["CapDrop"] == ["ALL"]
        and len(normalized) == len(additions)
        and normalized == (PREP_CAPS if prep else frozenset())
    )
    require(h["SecurityOpt"] in (["no-new-privileges"], ["no-new-privileges=true"]))
    require(h["RestartPolicy"]["Name"] == "no" and h["LogConfig"]["Type"] == "none")
    require(not any(h.get(k) for k in ("Binds", "Devices", "DeviceRequests", "PortBindings")))
    require(
        len(h["Ulimits"]) == 2
        and {v["Name"]: (v["Soft"], v["Hard"]) for v in h["Ulimits"]}
        == {"nofile": (fds, fds), "core": (0, 0)}
    )


def validate_diff(raw, report):
    rows = raw.decode("utf8", "strict").splitlines()
    require(len(rows) <= 20000)
    directories = set(report["directories"]) | {
        "/opt/maskgw",
        "/var/lib/rpm",
        "/var/lib/dnf",
    }
    for line in rows:
        action, path = line.split(" ", 1)
        require(action in ("A", "C") and path.startswith("/") and "\x00" not in path)
        if path in directories:
            continue
        if path == "/var/cache/ldconfig/aux-cache" and action == "A":
            aux = report.get("aux_cache", {})
            require(
                aux.get("action") == "retained-base-glibc"
                and aux.get("owner") == ["glibc", "x86_64"]
            )
            continue
        if any(
            path.startswith(top + "/")
            for top in (
                "/opt/maskgw",
                "/var/lib/rpm",
                "/var/lib/dnf",
                "/usr/lib/sysimage/rpm",
            )
        ):
            continue
        if path in ("/etc/passwd", "/etc/group", "/etc/ld.so.cache"):
            require(report["passwd_group_literal_append"])
            continue
        if action == "A" and path.startswith(("/usr/", "/etc/")) and path in report["new_paths"]:
            continue
        if path in ("/tmp", "/var/tmp", "/var/empty") and report["empty_dirs"][path]:
            continue
        raise RuntimeError("DIFF_REFUSED")


def verify_copy_origin(current, original_raw, expected_sha):
    require(hashlib.sha256(original_raw).hexdigest() == expected_sha)
    original = json.loads(original_raw)
    require(original["kind"] == current["kind"] == "oracle9-rpms-v1")
    before = {v["filename"]: v for v in original["files"] if v["filename"] != "runtime_probe.py"}
    after = {v["filename"]: v for v in current["files"] if v["filename"] != "runtime_probe.py"}
    require(len(before) == len(after) == 9 and before == after)


def decode_summary(raw):
    wire = json.loads(raw)
    require(type(wire) is dict and set(wire) == {"encoding", "raw_bytes", "data"})
    require(wire["encoding"] == "zlib-base64-v1" and type(wire["data"]) is str)
    require(type(wire["raw_bytes"]) is int and 0 < wire["raw_bytes"] <= 2 * 1024 * 1024)
    require(len(wire["data"]) <= 1024 * 1024)
    packed = base64.b64decode(wire["data"], validate=True)
    decoder = zlib.decompressobj()
    value = decoder.decompress(packed, 2 * 1024 * 1024 + 1)
    require(
        len(value) == wire["raw_bytes"]
        and decoder.eof
        and not decoder.unconsumed_tail
        and not decoder.unused_data
    )
    report = json.loads(value)
    require(type(report) is dict)
    return report


async def main(root):
    require(
        sys.flags.optimize == 0 and root.parent.resolve() == (HOME / "AppData/Local/Temp").resolve()
    )
    require(root.name.startswith("maskgw-oracle9-python-20261023-"))
    require(root.resolve().parent == root.parent.resolve() and not root.is_symlink())
    require(not getattr(root.stat(), "st_file_attributes", 0) & 0x400)
    state = json.loads((root / "attempt.json").read_bytes())
    require(
        state["kind"] == "maskgw-oracle9-python"
        and state["phase"] == "APP_READY"
        and state["invoked"] is False
    )
    require(re.fullmatch("[0-9a-f]{32}", state["task"]) and not (root / "result.json").exists())
    pins()
    payload = PAYLOAD.read_bytes()
    require(hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest() == state["payload_sha256"])
    payload_module = {"__name__": "_maskgw_pinned_runtime_policy", "__file__": str(PAYLOAD)}
    exec(compile(payload, str(PAYLOAD), "exec"), payload_module)
    payload_policy = payload_module["validate_verification_report"]
    require(hashlib.sha256(PAYLOAD.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == state["payload_sha256"])
    require(
        hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest() == state["program_sha256"]
    )
    downloaded = state.get("bundle_download_invoked") is True and state.get("bundle_origin") in (
        None,
        "download-v1",
    )
    copied = (
        state.get("bundle_download_invoked") is False
        and state.get("bundle_origin") == "verified-local-copy-v1"
    )
    require(state.get("bundle_ready") is True and (downloaded or copied))
    if copied:
        origin = REPO / "docs/poc/evidence/oracle9-rpm-download-result-20261023.json"
        require(
            hashlib.sha256(origin.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
            == state["bundle_origin_evidence_sha256"]
        )
        original = json.loads(origin.read_bytes())
        require(original["task"] == state["bundle_origin_task"])
        require(
            original["raw"]["bundle/bundle.json"]["sha256"]
            == state["bundle_origin_manifest_sha256"]
        )
    require(hashlib.sha256(DOWNLOADER.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == state["download_program_sha256"])
    download_module = runpy.run_path(str(DOWNLOADER))
    bundle_manifest = download_module["check_bundle"](root, state)
    if copied:
        verify_copy_origin(
            bundle_manifest,
            original["raw"]["bundle/bundle.json"]["utf8"].encode("utf8"),
            state["bundle_origin_manifest_sha256"],
        )
    state["invoked"] = True
    state["phase"] = "PREPARATION_CONSUMED"
    save(root / "attempt.json", state)
    mod = runpy.run_path(str(HELPER))
    bounded = mod["bounded"]
    result = {
        "profile": "oracle9-python",
        "task": state["task"],
        "commands": [],
        "outcome": "NOT_PASSED",
        "owned_cleanup": False,
        "inventory_restored": False,
    }
    tag = "maskgw-oracle9-python:" + state["task"]
    records = []
    stop = threading.Event()
    fired = threading.Event()
    active = {"cid": None}

    def watchdog():
        if not stop.wait(1200):
            fired.set()
            if active["cid"] is not None:
                try:
                    pins()
                    subprocess.run(
                        [
                            str(CLI),
                            "--context",
                            "desktop-linux",
                            "kill",
                            "--signal",
                            "KILL",
                            active["cid"],
                        ],
                        stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,
                        stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,
                        stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL,
                        env=mod["environment"](),
                        timeout=10,
                        check=False,
                    )
                except Exception:
                    pass

    thread = threading.Thread(target=watchdog, name="maskgw-oracle9-python-watchdog", daemon=False)

    async def cli(label, *args, timeout=10, limit=2 * 1024 * 1024):
        pins()
        result["stage"] = label
        t = time.monotonic()
        try:
            rc, raw = await bounded(
                [str(CLI), "--context", "desktop-linux", *args], timeout=timeout, limit=limit
            )
        except BaseException as e:
            category = (
                "CLI_TIMEOUT"
                if type(e) is TimeoutError
                else e.category
                if type(e) is mod["HostFault"]
                else "CLI_OS"
                if isinstance(e, OSError)
                else "CLI_FAULT"
            )
            result["commands"].append(
                {"name": label, "category": category, "exit": None, "seconds": time.monotonic() - t}
            )
            raise
        result["commands"].append(
            {
                "name": label,
                "exit": rc,
                "category": "OK" if rc == 0 else "NONZERO",
                "seconds": time.monotonic() - t,
                "bytes": len(raw),
                "sha256": hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),
            }
        )
        return rc, raw

    async def inspect(target):
        rc, raw = await cli("inspect-own", "inspect", "--type", "container", target)
        require(rc == 0)
        rows = json.loads(raw)
        require(type(rows) is list and len(rows) == 1)
        return rows[0]

    async def unused_tag():
        # image ls is successful even when absent; daemon errors never mean absent.
        rc, raw = await cli(
            "tag-collision",
            "image",
            "ls",
            "--no-trunc",
            "--format",
            "{{.Repository}}:{{.Tag}}",
            tag,
        )
        require(rc == 0 and not raw.strip())

    async def create(image, suffix, command, prep):
        name = "maskgw-ol9-python-" + state["task"][:12] + "-" + suffix
        record = {"name": name, "image": image, "cid": None}
        records.append(record)
        mb, fds, pids = ("2g", "256", "64") if prep else ("128m", "64", "16")
        args = [
            "create",
            "--pull",
            "never",
            "--name",
            name,
            "--label",
            "maskgw.task=" + state["task"],
            "--network",
            "none",
            "--ipc",
            "private",
            "--cgroupns",
            "private",
            "--user",
            "0:0" if prep else "10001:10001",
            "--cap-drop",
            "ALL",
            "--security-opt",
            "no-new-privileges=true",
            "--memory",
            mb,
            "--memory-swap",
            mb,
            "--pids-limit",
            pids,
            "--cpus",
            "1",
            "--shm-size",
            "1m",
            "--ulimit",
            "nofile=" + fds + ":" + fds,
            "--ulimit",
            "core=0:0",
            "--restart",
            "no",
            "--log-driver",
            "none",
            "--no-healthcheck",
        ]
        if prep:
            args += ["--entrypoint", "/bin/bash"]
            args += [v for cap in sorted(PREP_CAPS) for v in ("--cap-add", cap)]
        else:
            args += ["--read-only"]
        rc, raw = await cli("create-" + suffix, *args, image, *command, timeout=20)
        require(rc == 0 and re.fullmatch("[0-9a-f]{64}", raw.decode("ascii").strip()))
        record["cid"] = raw.decode("ascii").strip()
        info = await inspect(record["cid"])
        identity(info, name, state["task"], image)
        profile(info, image, command, prep)
        active["cid"] = record["cid"]
        return record

    try:
        rc, raw = await cli("version", "version", "--format", "{{json .Server}}")
        require(rc == 0 and json.loads(raw)["Os"] == "linux" and json.loads(raw)["Arch"] == "amd64")
        rc, raw = await cli("inventory-before", "ps", "-aq", "--no-trunc")
        require(rc == 0 and not raw.strip())
        rc, raw = await cli("daemon-memory", "info", "--format", "{{json .MemTotal}}")
        require(rc == 0)
        total = json.loads(raw)
        require(type(total) is int and total >= 8 * 1024 * 1024 * 1024)
        result["daemon_memory_total"] = total
        await unused_tag()
        rc, raw = await cli("base-image", "image", "inspect", IMAGE)
        require(rc == 0)
        base = json.loads(raw)[0]
        require(
            base["Id"] == IMAGE
            and base["Config"]["Env"] == [PATH_ENV]
            and base["RootFS"]["Layers"] == BASE_LAYERS
        )

"""One-shot vendor-runtime attestation; no gateway, database or client inputs."""

import base64
from collections import Counter
import errno
import hashlib
import json
import os
import pathlib
import ssl
import stat
import subprocess
import sys
import zlib

ROOT = pathlib.Path("/opt/maskgw")
QF = "%{NAME}|%{ARCH}|%{EPOCHNUM}|%{VERSION}|%{RELEASE}\n"
EXPECTED = {
    ("expat", "x86_64"): ("0", "2.5.0", "6.el9_8.7"),
    ("libnsl2", "x86_64"): ("0", "2.0.0", "1.el9"),
    ("libtirpc", "x86_64"): ("0", "1.3.3", "9.el9"),
    ("mpdecimal", "x86_64"): ("0", "2.5.1", "3.el9"),
    ("python3.11", "x86_64"): ("0", "3.11.13", "10.0.1.el9_8"),
    ("python3.11-libs", "x86_64"): ("0", "3.11.13", "10.0.1.el9_8"),
    ("python3.11-pip", "noarch"): ("0", "22.3.1", "6.el9"),
    ("python3.11-pip-wheel", "noarch"): ("0", "22.3.1", "6.el9"),
    ("python3.11-setuptools-wheel", "noarch"): ("0", "65.5.1", "5.el9"),
}
APPENDS = {
    "passwd": b"maskgw:x:10001:10001:Mask Gateway:/var/empty:/sbin/nologin\n",
    "group": b"maskgw:x:10001:\n",
}
RESTORED_DIRS = ("/usr/share/man", "/usr/share/man/man1", "/var/cache/ldconfig")
VERIFY_POLICY = "oracle9-python-restored-directories-v1"
AUX_PATH = "/var/cache/ldconfig/aux-cache"
AUX_CACHE = pathlib.Path(AUX_PATH)


def validate_directory_facts(facts):
    require(type(facts) is dict and set(facts) == set(RESTORED_DIRS))
    for v in facts.values():
        validate_directory_fact(v)


def validate_directory_fact(v):
    require(v.get("kind") == "directory" and v.get("symlink") is False)
    require(type(v.get("uid")) is int and type(v.get("gid")) is int and v["uid"] == v["gid"] == 0)
    require(type(v.get("mode")) is int and 0 <= v["mode"] <= 0o7777)
    require(not v["mode"] & 0o7022 and v["mode"] & 0o500 == 0o500)


def directory_facts():
    facts = {}
    for name in RESTORED_DIRS:
        p = pathlib.Path(name)
        try:
            s = p.lstat()
        except FileNotFoundError:
            facts[name] = {"kind": "absent"}
            continue
        facts[name] = {
            "kind": "directory" if stat.S_ISDIR(s.st_mode) else "other",
            "symlink": stat.S_ISLNK(s.st_mode),
            "uid": s.st_uid,
            "gid": s.st_gid,
            "mode": stat.S_IMODE(s.st_mode),
        }
    return facts


def validate_verification_report(value):
    require(
        value.get("verification_policy") == VERIFY_POLICY
        and value.get("base_verify_accepted") is True
    )
    unchanged = value.get("base_verify_unchanged")
    require(type(unchanged) is bool)
    if unchanged:
        require(
            value.get("restored_directories") == [] and value.get("restored_directory_facts") == {}
        )
    else:
        require(value.get("restored_directories") == list(RESTORED_DIRS))
        validate_directory_facts(value.get("restored_directory_facts"))
    aux = value.get("aux_cache")
    require(type(aux) is dict)
    if aux.get("action") == "absent":
        require(set(aux) == {"action"})
    else:
        require(aux.get("action") in ("retained-base-glibc", "removed-unowned"))
        expected = {"action", "path", "bytes", "sha256", "uid", "gid", "mode"}
        if aux["action"] == "retained-base-glibc":
            expected.add("owner")
            require(aux.get("owner") == ["glibc", "x86_64"])
        require(set(aux) == expected and aux["path"] == AUX_PATH)
        require(
            type(aux["uid"]) is int and type(aux["gid"]) is int and aux["uid"] == aux["gid"] == 0
        )
        require(
            type(aux["mode"]) is int and 0 <= aux["mode"] <= 0o7777 and not aux["mode"] & 0o6022
        )
        require(type(aux["bytes"]) is int and 0 < aux["bytes"] <= 16 * 1024 * 1024)
        require(
            type(aux["sha256"]) is str
            and len(aux["sha256"]) == 64
            and all(c in "0123456789abcdef" for c in aux["sha256"])
        )


def handle_aux_cache(before, facts):
    fact = facts["/var/cache/ldconfig"]
    if fact.get("kind") == "absent":
        return {"action": "absent"}
    validate_directory_fact(fact)
    p = AUX_CACHE
    names = {v.name for v in p.parent.iterdir()}
    require(names <= {"aux-cache"})
    if not names:
        return {"action": "absent"}
    require((ROOT / "cache-dir-before.txt").read_bytes() == b"absent\n")
    require(verify_lines(before).count("missing     /var/cache/ldconfig") == 1)
    s = p.lstat()
    require(stat.S_ISREG(s.st_mode) and s.st_uid == s.st_gid == 0)
    require(not s.st_mode & 0o6022 and 0 < s.st_size <= 16 * 1024 * 1024)
    data_hash = hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    q = subprocess.run(
        ["rpm", "-qf", "--qf", "%{NAME}|%{ARCH}\n", str(p)],
        stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,
        capture_output=True,
        timeout=60,
        check=False,
        env={"PATH": os.environ["PATH"], "LC_ALL": "C"},
    )
    print(
        "@@AUX_CACHE_OWNER@@"
        + json.dumps(
            {
                "exit": q.returncode,
                "stdout": q.stdout[:4096].decode("utf8", errors="replace"),
                "stderr_bytes": len(q.stderr),
                "stderr_sha256": hashlib.sha256(q.stderr).hexdigest(),
            }
        )
    )
    require(not q.stderr and len(q.stdout) <= 4096)
    info = {
        "path": AUX_PATH,
        "bytes": s.st_size,
        "sha256": data_hash,
        "uid": s.st_uid,
        "gid": s.st_gid,
        "mode": stat.S_IMODE(s.st_mode),
    }
    if q.returncode == 0:
        require(q.stdout == b"glibc|x86_64\n")
        info["action"] = "retained-base-glibc"
        info["owner"] = ["glibc", "x86_64"]
    else:
        require(
            q.returncode == 1 and q.stdout == f"file {p} is not owned by any package\n".encode()
        )
        p.unlink()
        info["action"] = "removed-unowned"
    return info


def require(value):
    if not value:
        raise RuntimeError("RUNTIME_ATTESTATION_REFUSED")


def rpm(*args, allow_verify=False):
    p = subprocess.run(
        ["rpm", *args],
        stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,
        capture_output=True,
        timeout=60,
        check=False,
        env={"PATH": os.environ["PATH"], "LC_ALL": "C"},
    )
    if p.stderr or p.returncode not in ((0, 1) if allow_verify else (0,)):
        print(
            "@@RPM_DIAGNOSTIC@@"
            + json.dumps(
                {
                    "operation": args[0] if args else "NONE",
                    "exit": p.returncode,
                    "stderr_bytes": len(p.stderr),
                    "stderr_sha256": hashlib.sha256(p.stderr).hexdigest(),
                    "public_stderr_prefix": p.stderr[:4096].decode("utf8", errors="replace"),
                },
                sort_keys=True,
            )
        )
    require(not p.stderr and p.returncode in ((0, 1) if allow_verify else (0,)))
    require(len(p.stdout) <= 2 * 1024 * 1024)
    return p.stdout.decode("utf8", "strict")


def inventory(text):
    rows = {}
    keys = {}
    for line in text.splitlines():
        name, arch, epoch, version, release = line.split("|")
        if name == "gpg-pubkey":
            require((version, release) not in keys)
            keys[version, release] = (arch, epoch)
            continue
        require((name, arch) not in rows)
        rows[name, arch] = (epoch, version, release)
    return rows, keys


def verify_lines(raw):
    # Declared, separately byte-checked changes only. All other old RPM
    # deviations must equal the recorded base, never silently become accepted.
    return sorted(
        line
        for line in raw.splitlines()
        if line.rsplit(" ", 1)[-1] not in ("/etc/passwd", "/etc/group", "/etc/ld.so.cache")
    )


def compare_verification(before, after, facts=None):
    a, b = verify_lines(before), verify_lines(after)
    result = {
        "verification_policy": VERIFY_POLICY,
        "base_verify_accepted": True,
        "base_verify_unchanged": a == b,
        "restored_directories": [],
        "restored_directory_facts": {},
    }
    if a == b:
        return result
    if a != b:
        removed = list((Counter(a) - Counter(b)).elements())
        added = list((Counter(b) - Counter(a)).elements())
        expected = ["missing     " + p for p in RESTORED_DIRS]
        if not added and Counter(removed) == Counter(expected):
            validate_directory_facts(facts)
            result["restored_directories"] = list(RESTORED_DIRS)
            result["restored_directory_facts"] = facts
            return result
        print(
            "@@RPM_VERIFY_DIFF@@"
            + json.dumps(
                {
                    "before_count": len(a),
                    "after_count": len(b),
                    "before_sha256": hashlib.sha256(before.encode()).hexdigest(),
                    "after_sha256": hashlib.sha256(after.encode()).hexdigest(),
                    "removed_count": len(removed),
                    "added_count": len(added),
                    "removed": [v[:512] for v in removed[:40]],
                    "added": [v[:512] for v in added[:40]],
                },
                sort_keys=True,
            )
        )
    require(a == b)
    return result


def finish():
    require(sys.version_info[:3] == (3, 11, 13))
    before, before_keys = inventory((ROOT / "rpm-before.txt").read_text())
    after_text = rpm("-qa", "--qf", QF)
    after, after_keys = inventory(after_text)
    allowed_packages, allowed_keys = inventory((ROOT / "allowed-keys.txt").read_text())
    require(not allowed_packages and allowed_keys)
    require(all(after_keys.get(k) == v for k, v in before_keys.items()))
    require(all(k in before_keys or allowed_keys.get(k) == v for k, v in after_keys.items()))
    require(all(after.get(key) == value for key, value in before.items()))
    require(all(after.get(key) == value for key, value in EXPECTED.items()))
    require(pathlib.Path("/etc/os-release").read_bytes() == (ROOT / "os-before").read_bytes())
    os_release = pathlib.Path("/etc/os-release").read_text()
    require('\nID="ol"\n' in "\n" + os_release or "\nID=ol\n" in "\n" + os_release)
    require('\nVERSION_ID="9.8"\n' in "\n" + os_release)

    before_verification = (ROOT / "verify-before.txt").read_text()
    facts = directory_facts()
    aux_cache = handle_aux_cache(before_verification, facts)
    require(aux_cache["action"] != "retained-base-glibc" or ("glibc", "x86_64") in before)
    verification = rpm("-Va", allow_verify=True)
    (ROOT / "verify-after.txt").write_text(verification)
    verification_result = compare_verification(before_verification, verification, facts)
    added = {key for key in after if key not in before}
    require(added == set(EXPECTED))
    require(not rpm("-V", *sorted({name for name, arch in added}), allow_verify=True).strip())

    for name, extra in APPENDS.items():
        p = pathlib.Path("/etc") / name
        original = (ROOT / (name + "-before")).read_bytes()

    # Every old /etc regular file is hashed by the shell before installation.
    for line in (ROOT / "etc-before.txt").read_text().splitlines():

    previous = set((ROOT / "paths-before.txt").read_text().splitlines())
    # Public RPMs are inputs, not runtime contents. Remove only the nine
    # exact, already checked regular files; keep the manifest/headers/hashes.
    manifest = json.loads((ROOT / "bundle.json").read_bytes())

    owner = None
    ownership = rpm(
        "-q",
        *sorted({name for name, arch in added}),
        "--qf",
        "@@PKG@@%{NAME}|%{ARCH}\n[%{FILENAMES}\n]",
    )
    for line in ownership.splitlines():
        if line.startswith("@@PKG@@"):

            require(owner in added)
        else:
            require(owner is not None and line.startswith("/"))
            owned_paths[line] = owner
    new_nodes = {}
    checked_privileges = 0
    for top in ("/usr", "/etc", "/opt/maskgw", "/var/cache/ldconfig"):
        for p in pathlib.Path(top).rglob("*"):

                "/etc/passwd",

        "/usr",
        "/etc",
        "/opt",
        "/var",
        "/var/lib",
        "/var/cache",
        "/var/log",
        "/tmp",
        "/var/tmp",
    ]
    for top in ("/usr", "/etc"):
        for p in pathlib.Path(top).rglob("*"):

    result = {
        "python": list(sys.version_info[:3]),
        "executable": sys.executable,
        "openssl": ssl.OPENSSL_VERSION,
        "rpm_before": (ROOT / "rpm-before.txt").read_text(),
        "rpm_after": after_text,
        "added": [list(v) for v in sorted(added)],
        "gpg_keys_before": [list(k) for k in sorted(before_keys)],
        "gpg_keys_after": [list(k) for k in sorted(after_keys)],
        "signatures": rpm("-qa", "--qf", "%{NAME}|%{ARCH}|%{RSAHEADER:pgpsig}\n"),
        **verification_result,
        "aux_cache": aux_cache,
        "os_unchanged": True,
        "new_nodes": new_nodes,
        "passwd_group_literal_append": True,
        "no_new_privilege_bits_or_caps": True,
        "privilege_checked_nodes": checked_privileges,
        "directories": directories,
        "empty_dirs": {
            p: not any(pathlib.Path(p).iterdir())
            for p in ("/tmp", "/var/tmp", "/var/log", "/var/empty")
        },
    }
    data = (json.dumps(result, sort_keys=True) + "\n").encode()
    require(len(data) <= 8 * 1024 * 1024)
    (ROOT / "runtime.json").write_bytes(data)
    validate_verification_report(result)
    summary = {k: v for k, v in result.items() if k not in ("new_nodes", "signatures")}
    summary["new_paths"] = sorted(new_nodes)
    summary["runtime_sha256"] = hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
    summary["runtime_bytes"] = len(data)
    raw_summary = json.dumps(summary, sort_keys=True).encode()
    require(len(raw_summary) <= 2 * 1024 * 1024)
    packed = base64.b64encode(zlib.compress(raw_summary, 9)).decode("ascii")
    require(len(packed) <= 1024 * 1024)
    print(
        "@@RUNTIME@@"
        + json.dumps({"encoding": "zlib-base64-v1", "raw_bytes": len(raw_summary), "data": packed})
    )


def probe():

    import grp

    import sqlite3

        json.dumps(
            {
                "kind": "oracle9-python-probe",
                "python": v["python"],

"""One bounded download of nine public Oracle RPMs; never executes an RPM."""

import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
import stat
import subprocess
import sys

CURL = Path("C:/Windows/System32/curl.exe")
CURL_SHA = "73d24149ff289afc49ec41f08918ef9faa727d39ad993e929757dc2ddafab805"
REPO = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
PAYLOAD = REPO / "deploy/oracle9_python_payload.py"
RPM_ROWS = (
    ("baseos/latest", "expat", "2.5.0", "6.el9_8.7", "x86_64"),
    ("appstream", "libnsl2", "2.0.0", "1.el9", "x86_64"),
    ("baseos/latest", "libtirpc", "1.3.3", "9.el9", "x86_64"),
    ("appstream", "mpdecimal", "2.5.1", "3.el9", "x86_64"),
    ("appstream", "python3.11", "3.11.13", "10.0.1.el9_8", "x86_64"),
    ("appstream", "python3.11-libs", "3.11.13", "10.0.1.el9_8", "x86_64"),
    ("appstream", "python3.11-pip", "22.3.1", "6.el9", "noarch"),
    ("appstream", "python3.11-pip-wheel", "22.3.1", "6.el9", "noarch"),
    ("appstream", "python3.11-setuptools-wheel", "65.5.1", "5.el9", "noarch"),
)
MAX_FILE = 16 * 1024 * 1024
MAX_TOTAL = 64 * 1024 * 1024


def require(value):
    if not value:
        raise RuntimeError("BUNDLE_REFUSED")


def regular(path):
    s = path.lstat()
    require(stat.S_ISREG(s.st_mode) and not getattr(s, "st_file_attributes", 0) & 0x400)


def manifest_rows():
    result = []
    for repo, name, version, release, arch in RPM_ROWS:
        filename = f"{name}-{version}-{release}.{arch}.rpm"
        require(re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+\.rpm", filename))
        result.append(
            {
                "filename": filename,
                "url": f"https://yum.oracle.com/repo/OracleLinux/OL9/{repo}/x86_64/getPackage/{filename}",
                "header": f"{name}|{arch}|0|{version}|{release}",
            }
        )
    return result


def curl_args(path, url, limit):
    require(0 < limit <= MAX_FILE)
    require(url in {r["url"] for r in manifest_rows()})
    return [
        str(CURL),
        "-q",
        "--noproxy",
        "*",
        "--proto",
        "=https",
        "--max-redirs",
        "0",
        "--no-ssl-auto-client-cert",
        "--fail",
        "--silent",
        "--connect-timeout",
        "10",
        "--max-time",
        "30",
        "--max-filesize",
        str(limit),
        "--output",
        str(path),
        "--write-out",
        "%{http_code}\n%{url_effective}",
        "--url",
        url,
    ]


def environment():
    return {
        key: os.environ[key] for key in ("SystemRoot", "WINDIR", "TEMP", "TMP") if key in os.environ
    }


def write_new(path, data):
    with path.open("xb") as f:
        f.write(data)
        f.flush()
        os.fsync(f.fileno())


def save_state(path, value):
    temp = path.with_suffix(".next")
    write_new(temp, (json.dumps(value) + "\n").encode())
    os.replace(temp, path)


def check_bundle(root, state):
    bundle = root / "bundle"
    require(bundle.is_dir() and not bundle.is_symlink())
    require(not getattr(bundle.stat(), "st_file_attributes", 0) & 0x400)
    for name in ("bundle.json", "inputs.sha256", "expected-rpms.txt"):
        regular(bundle / name)
        require((bundle / name).stat().st_size <= 16384)
    mraw = (bundle / "bundle.json").read_bytes()
    require(
        len(mraw) <= 16384 and hashlib.sha256(mraw).hexdigest() == state["bundle_manifest_sha256"]
    )
    m = json.loads(mraw)
    require(set(m) == {"kind", "files"} and m["kind"] == "oracle9-rpms-v1")
    require(type(m["files"]) is list and len(m["files"]) == 10)
    names = [v["filename"] for v in m["files"]]
    require(len(names) == len(set(names)))
    expected = {v["filename"]: v for v in manifest_rows()}
    require(set(names) == set(expected) | {"runtime_probe.py"})
    require(
        {p.name for p in bundle.iterdir()}
        == set(names) | {"bundle.json", "inputs.sha256", "expected-rpms.txt"}
    )
    total = 0
    for v in m["files"]:
        name = v["filename"]
        require(
            set(v)
            == (
                {"filename", "url", "header", "bytes", "sha256"}
                if name in expected
                else {"filename", "bytes", "sha256"}
            )
        )
        require(re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+", name) is not None)
        p = bundle / name
        regular(p)
        require(type(v["bytes"]) is int and 0 < v["bytes"] <= MAX_FILE)
        require(p.stat().st_size == v["bytes"])
        data = p.read_bytes()
        require(hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() == v["sha256"])
        if name in expected:
            require(v["url"] == expected[name]["url"] and v["header"] == expected[name]["header"])
            require(data[:4] == b"\xed\xab\xee\xdb")
            total += len(data)
        else:
            require(v["sha256"] == state["payload_sha256"])
    require(total <= MAX_TOTAL)
    # These auxiliary inputs are regenerated byte-for-byte, never trusted by name.
    headers = ("\n".join(sorted(v["header"] for v in expected.values())) + "\n").encode()
    require((bundle / "expected-rpms.txt").read_bytes() == headers)
    checked = [(v["filename"], v["sha256"]) for v in m["files"]]
    checked += [
        ("bundle.json", hashlib.sha256(mraw).hexdigest()),
        ("expected-rpms.txt", hashlib.sha256(headers).hexdigest()),
    ]
    sums = "".join(f"{h}  {name}\n" for name, h in sorted(checked)).encode()
    require((bundle / "inputs.sha256").read_bytes() == sums)
    for name in ("bundle.json", "expected-rpms.txt", "inputs.sha256"):
        regular(bundle / name)
    return m


def main(root):
    require(sys.flags.optimize == 0 and root.name.startswith("maskgw-oracle9-python-20261023-"))
    require(root.parent.resolve() == (Path(os.environ["LOCALAPPDATA"]) / "Temp").resolve())
    require(root.resolve().parent == root.parent.resolve() and not root.is_symlink())
    require(not getattr(root.stat(), "st_file_attributes", 0) & 0x400)
    state_path = root / "attempt.json"
    state = json.loads(state_path.read_bytes())
    require(
        state["kind"] == "maskgw-oracle9-python"
        and state["invoked"] is False
        and state["desktop_initial"] == "unobserved"
        and "phase" not in state
        and not state.get("bundle_download_invoked")
        and state.get("bundle_ready") is False
    )
    require(
        hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest() == state["download_program_sha256"]
    )
    payload = PAYLOAD.read_bytes()
    require(hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest() == state["payload_sha256"])
    require(hashlib.sha256(CURL.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == CURL_SHA)
    state["bundle_download_invoked"] = True
    save_state(state_path, state)
    bundle = root / "bundle"
    bundle.mkdir()
    result = {"kind": "oracle9-download-v1", "outcome": "NOT_PASSED", "files": []}
    total = 0
    try:
        for entry in manifest_rows():
            name = entry["filename"]
            result["current_filename"] = name
            p = bundle / (name + ".part")
            write_new(p, b"")
            p_limit = min(MAX_FILE, MAX_TOTAL - total)
            proc = subprocess.run(
                curl_args(p, entry["url"], p_limit),
                stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,
                stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
                stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL,
                env=environment(),
                timeout=35,
                check=False,
            )
            result["files"].append({"filename": name, "exit": proc.returncode})
            require(proc.returncode == 0 and len(proc.stdout) <= 4096)
            require(proc.stdout.replace(b"\r\n", b"\n") == ("200\n" + entry["url"]).encode("ascii"))
            regular(p)
            require(0 < p.stat().st_size <= p_limit)
            with p.open("r+b") as f:
                require(f.read(4) == b"\xed\xab\xee\xdb")
                f.flush()
                os.fsync(f.fileno())
            entry["bytes"] = p.stat().st_size
            entry["sha256"] = hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
            total += entry["bytes"]
            os.replace(p, bundle / name)
            result["files"][-1].update(entry)
        write_new(bundle / "runtime_probe.py", payload)
        inputs = [dict(v) for v in result["files"]]
        for v in inputs:
            del v["exit"]
        inputs.append(
            {
                "filename": "runtime_probe.py",
                "bytes": len(payload),
                "sha256": hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest(),
            }
        )
        mraw = (
            json.dumps({"kind": "oracle9-rpms-v1", "files": inputs}, sort_keys=True) + "\n"
        ).encode()
        write_new(bundle / "bundle.json", mraw)
        headers = ("\n".join(sorted(v["header"] for v in manifest_rows())) + "\n").encode()
        write_new(bundle / "expected-rpms.txt", headers)
        checked = [(v["filename"], v["sha256"]) for v in inputs]
        checked += [
            ("bundle.json", hashlib.sha256(mraw).hexdigest()),
            ("expected-rpms.txt", hashlib.sha256(headers).hexdigest()),
        ]
        write_new(
            bundle / "inputs.sha256", "".join(f"{h}  {n}\n" for n, h in sorted(checked)).encode()
        )
        state["bundle_manifest_sha256"] = hashlib.sha256(mraw).hexdigest()
        check_bundle(root, state)
        state["bundle_ready"] = True
        result["outcome"] = "BUNDLE_DOWNLOADED"
    except BaseException:
        state["bundle_ready"] = False
    finally:
        save_state(state_path, state)
        write_new(root / "download.json", (json.dumps(result, sort_keys=True) + "\n").encode())
    print(json.dumps(result, sort_keys=True))
    return 0 if result["outcome"] == "BUNDLE_DOWNLOADED" else 2


if __name__ == "__main__":
    require(len(sys.argv) == 2)
    raise SystemExit(main(Path(sys.argv[1])))
